hook.en: Using suction cups on the skin to lift the tissue, either held still or moved, to ease tightness and pain.
hook.ur: Dry cupping mein cup ke zariye negative pressure create karke skin aur superficial tissue par sensory aur mechanical input diya jata hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Myofascial Decompression / Dry Cupping is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Myofascial Decompression / Dry Cupping kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: Myofascial decompression (dry cupping) uses cups that create negative pressure, which lifts the skin and tissue slightly. Cups may be left in place (static) or glided over the area with oil (dynamic).
text.ur: Non-invasive negative-pressure cupping ko symptoms modulate karne aur movement practice se pehle adjunct ke taur par use kiya ja sakta hai, magar evidence aur claims conservative rakhne chahiye.

simpler.en: Using suction cups on the skin to lift the tissue, either held still or moved, to ease tightness and pain.
simpler.ur: Dry cupping mein cup ke zariye negative pressure create karke skin aur superficial tissue par sensory aur mechanical input diya jata hai.

text.en: Like lifting a sticky sheet of tape off a surface instead of pushing down on it. Pressure goes up, not down.
text.ur: Jaise chipakti tape ko surface par dabane ke bajaye usay upar uthana. Pressure neeche nahi, upar ki taraf jata hai.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** It is the opposite of compression: tissue is lifted, not pressed.
**2.** Circular marks are from suction and are not a sign that toxins were removed.
**3.** Always check skin and recheck movement or pain.
text.ur: Dry cupping local negative pressure banati hai jo skin aur superficial soft tissue ko deform karti hai aur strong sensory input deti hai. Proposed effects mein pain sensitivity, local blood flow aur movement tolerance mein short-term tabdeeli shamil hai, lekin clinically important benefit ke saboot uncertain hain. Isay toxins nikalne, adhesions torne ya fascia ko permanently badalne ke taur par pesh na karein.

question.ur: Pehle vocabulary — clinicians yeh lafz bohat use karte hain. **Negative pressure** ka matlab kya hai?

text.en:
So when does **Myofascial Decompression / Dry Cupping** make sense?
• Muscle tightness or soreness where a patient prefers or tolerates cupping.
• As an adjunct before movement exercises.
text.ur: Selected musculoskeletal pain jahan patient adjunctive care ka trial chahta ho; perceived soft-tissue tightness; active exercise se pehle short-term movement preparation.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Skin infection, open wounds, sunburn or fragile skin.
• Bleeding disorders or blood-thinning medicines.
• Over varicose veins, pregnancy abdomen or low back, or deep vein thrombosis.
text.ur:
Anticoagulant ya antiplatelet medicines, nazuk skin, reduced sensation, varicosities aur excessive bruising ki history.
Khula zakhm, burn ya active skin infection; suspected DVT ya thrombophlebitis; uncontrolled bleeding disorder; acute serious illness; ya aisi jagah jahan suction vulnerable tissue ko nuqsan de sakti ho.
Bruise marks ko toxins nikalne ya treatment success ka proof samajhna ghalat hai. Skin fragility, bleeding risk, anticoagulants, sensation problems aur patient concerns ko consider karein; blistering, severe pain ya skin injury par stop karein.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Check skin and ask about medicines
steps.detail: Look for wounds, rashes and ask about blood thinners.

steps.title: Apply light suction
steps.detail: Start with a mild lift and check comfort.

steps.title: Static or dynamic
steps.detail: Hold for several minutes or glide slowly with oil.

steps.title: Monitor
steps.detail: Remove if pain, dizziness or excessive redness appears.

steps.title: Retest and warn about marks
steps.detail: Retest movement. Explain marks fade in days.

beats.ur:
1. Skin, vascular status, sensation, medicines aur relevant medical history screen karein.
2. Samjha dein ke temporary gol discoloration ho sakti hai aur consent lein.
3. Intact skin par conservative suction ke sath munasib cup lagayein.
4. Static placement ya controlled movement sirf tab use karein jab comfortable aur anatomically safe ho.
5. Pehli exposure limited rakhein, skin aur symptoms monitor karein, aur cup ko tissue trauma ke baghair remove karein.
6. Movement ya function dobara assess karke short-term benefit ko active rehabilitation ke sath combine karein.

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: static cupping about 5-10 minutes with mild to moderate suction; dynamic cupping a few minutes. Use mild suction first.
text.ur: Sab se kam suction use karein jo tolerable ho. Aam tor par ek region par takreeban 3–10 minutes ki short application prolonged aggressive suction se zyada defensible hai. First-time, sensitive ya asani se bruise hone walay patients mein duration aur suction kam rakhein.

beats.patient: Aisha, 31, tight upper back from desk work.
beats.assessment: Tight muscles, no skin issues, no blood thinners.
beats.treatment: Two cups placed for 6 minutes with mild suction.
beats.reassess: Her shoulder movement feels easier. You explain the marks and add stretches.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Farz karein patient adjunctive cupping ka trial chahta hai. Screening aur consent ke baad clinician conservative application karta hai aur movement dobara check karta hai. Zyada marks banana goal nahi. Yeh illustrative example hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Using strong suction at first.
• Promising detoxification.
• Leaving cups on too long.

text.en: Some studies suggest short-term pain relief, though the quality is low and placebo effects are likely. Claims about detoxification are not supported.
text.ur: Cupping se kuch patients ko temporary symptom relief mil sakta hai, lekin proposed mechanisms aur long-term benefits ke liye evidence limited ya variable ho sakta hai. Isay established rehabilitation ka automatic replacement na banayein.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Lift the tissue gently, protect the skin, and measure real change.**
text.ur: Zyada discoloration ka matlab behtar treatment nahi. Cupping ko exercise, loading ya medical assessment ka substitute na banayein. Agar comparable sign mein meaningful change na ho to aadat ke taur par technique repeat na karein.
